input.quote: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
input.rationale: Section 10.3(A) binds Customer to obtain all Monthly Base Fee Services from M&I for the entire Term, and Section 6.8 requires Customer to use M&I primarily for Bankcard Services data processing. Both are sole-supplier/sourcing commitments on Customer that run for the full Term with no category-and-12-month limit and no automatic exit for service level or delivery failures, so they fail the fallback and sit in walk-away territory. Our edits make M&I a non-exclusive provider and confirm Customer's freedom to use other providers for bankcard processing, without touching the Monthly Base Fee pricing acknowledgment or M&I's own service obligations.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Remove Customer's obligations to source all Monthly Base Fee Services, and Bankcard Services processing, from M&I.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a full-term commitment to obtain all Monthly Base Fee Services (and primarily Bankcard Services) from M&I with no performance-based exit, so we have made M&I a non-exclusive provider and confirmed we may use other providers. If exclusivity is essential, we could discuss a 12-month, category-limited commitment that ends automatically on any service level or delivery date failure.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
ops.newText: M&I shall be a non-exclusive provider of the Services, and Customer shall not be required to obtain any of the Services from M&I.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees to use M&I primarily for Customer's Bankcard Services data processing.
ops.newText: Customer may obtain Bankcard Services data processing from M&I or from any other provider.
